title: Orthogonality of Walsh characters
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S,T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The uniform average over $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ of the product of the Walsh characters indexed by $S$ and $T$ is $1$ when $S=T$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinates
$T$ is a subset of the coordinates
